statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one entry whose vendor or product fields reference SonicWall SMA1000, with a dateAdded value between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: A fetch of the CISA KEV catalog on the deadline shows at least one SMA1000 entry with dateAdded between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-30 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry referencing SonicWall SMA1000 carries a dateAdded value inside the 2026-09-03 to 2026-09-30 window.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
